== Lead photograph (30 Oct 2026) ==
The lead is a crop of a Facebook photograph posted 6 April 2019. The Facebook photo viewer names Tony Prokes. Identification: distinctive name plus Gold 64 FL on the Decipher Squadron roster (Chicago, Il). The Facebook profile is facebook.com/tony.prokes (From Chicago, Illinois).
Wiki File is the dest JPEG of the photograph. The File page Preserved copy is the Facebook photo-viewer screenshot. Identification stays on Talk. See [[:File:Tony Prokes portrait.jpg]] and [[:File:Tony Prokes Facebook portrait.jpg]].
